svg.title: What I do · What I do
svg.desc: What I do. Four kinds of work, each with the projects that show it. Full-stack products: Interface, API, data model and deployment, designed and delivered as one piece of work. (Bayyan, Brain-Book, K9 dashboard) Cloud on AWS: Serverless backends and IoT ingestion on AWS, and moving production systems between AWS and on-premises servers. (K9 backend, RDS to on-prem, DRS replication fix) Applied AI: Retrieval, detection and anomaly flagging built into products, with the supporting evidence shown to the user. (Guidely, Detecto, Bedrock in K9) Systems programming: An HTTP server on epoll, a Unix shell and a ray tracer, each written without a framework. (localhost, 0-shell, rt)
